name: attachment
useFor: Show a file attached to an email, a message or a draft. Set state to idle while it waits, uploading or processing while it moves, error when it failed (say why in AttachmentDescription), and done when it is ready. Add AttachmentTrigger to open the file and AttachmentAction for remove or retry. Lay several out in an AttachmentGroup, which scrolls sideways.
constraints: A colored card behind the file
A spinner over the whole card
An icon that moves on hover
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the webhook cards (white, field edge, 8px corners) and the pink channel tiles of Create Agent Identity
